entities.name: Pedro de la Rosa
entities.description: Returned to Formula One with HRT after being without a full-time drive since the 2010 Italian Grand Prix.

entities.name: Narain Karthikeyan
entities.description: Returned to Formula One with HRT after making a one-race appearance at the Indian Grand Prix.

entities.name: HRT
entities.description: Team that Pedro de la Rosa and Narain Karthikeyan returned to in 2012.

entities.name: Vitantonio Liuzzi
entities.description: Drove for HRT in 2011 and joined the Indian i1 Super Series.

entities.name: Dani Clos
entities.description: Former GP2 Series driver confirmed as one of HRT's testing and reserve drivers.

entities.name: Ma Qinghua
entities.description: First ever Chinese driver to step into a Formula 1 car, confirmed as one of HRT's testing and reserve drivers.

entities.name: Jérôme d'Ambrosio
entities.description: Left Marussia after the 2011 Brazilian Grand Prix and joined Lotus F1 as their third driver.

entities.name: Lotus F1
entities.description: Team that Jérôme d'Ambrosio joined as their third driver.

entities.name: Charles Pic
entities.description: Joined Marussia, replacing Jérôme d'Ambrosio after placing fourth in the 2011 GP2 Series.

entities.name: Marussia
entities.description: Then known as Virgin Racing, the team that Charles Pic joined.

entities.name: 2012 Formula One World Championship
entities.description: The championship year in which these driver changes occurred.
